name: proj-retrospective
description: Runs a sprint retrospective that reviews last retro's action first, picks a format for this sprint's question, groups the team's input into themes and ends in one improvement with an owner and a check date, plus the items that belong above the team. Use for "run proj-retrospective", "sprint retrospective", "plan our retro", "retro format", "our retro actions never change anything", "write up the retro", "retro themes", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
